proposal_patterns.name: Clojure MCP System Analysis (Initial)
proposal_patterns.summary: Initial understanding of Clojure MCP: AI-assisted Clojure development via REPL, specialized editing tools, context management. Key for Python port.

proposal_patterns.name: Clojure MCP Customization
proposal_patterns.summary: ClojureMCP is a framework. Users build custom servers by selecting/modifying tools, prompts, resources. Core API vs. example main.

proposal_patterns.name: Clojure MCP Tool Definition
proposal_patterns.summary: Dual tool definition: 1. Multimethods (structured, integrated), 2. Simple Maps (portable, lightweight). Both use schemas and callbacks. Promotes 'core vs. tool' separation.

proposal_patterns.name: Clojure MCP Server Assembly
proposal_patterns.summary: The 'main.clj' file acts as a manifest, importing and registering selected tools, prompts, and resources with the core MCP server API. Demonstrates concrete server configuration.

proposal_patterns.name: unified_read_file Analysis
proposal_patterns.summary: unified_read_file uses rewrite-clj for structural Clojure parsing, pattern matching (name/content), and generates collapsed views. Reuses logic from form_edit (view generation) and read_file (timestamps). Shows deep language awareness.
